classification.question_topic: Asking whether they can intentionally reach the Mall World via dreams or meditation; notes they typically arrive only after traumatic nightmares and that medication stopped dreaming.
classification.skip_reason: Primarily a question/meta post with only general recurring-dream statements and no specific scene-by-scene dream report or distinct locations to map.

meta.author_theory: Mentions possibility it is a metaphysical place and asks about accessing it intentionally via dreams/meditation.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological observations present only at a general level: (1) access condition: they 'can only get there after a very traumatic nightmare' and during 'bad stuff in real life'; (2) social quality: 'people there seemed...real' yet 'unlike me'; (3) environmental control: 'I could shape the mall any way I liked'; (4) medication effect: mood stabilizer leads to 'no more nightmares' and 'I don’t dream'/'knocks me out' with 'sleep very peacefully'. No specific mall scenes, sensory details (light, layout), or discrete events were described to encode as locations/interactions.
